profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi! I am a mechanical engineer turned software engineer. I love to learn new things, and draw experience from a wide set of industries, including fintech, sustainable materials, manufacturing, and aerospace.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on internal enterprise services for our Data Platform, including UIs, component libraries, MFE layer, micro-services, and platform standards.

positions.title: Mechanical / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped develop an internal platform for material design and optimization, powered by machine learning.

Additionally, led a team of engineers in the technical development of novel sustainable materials and the build out of Cruz Foam's first manufacturing facility.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Worked within a cross functional team of mechanical, electrical, and software engineers to design state of the art manufacturing equipment.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Worked for a heavy equipment manufacturer designing new products for the mining industry.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Designed, analyzed, and prototyped solutions for the development of new aircrafts.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

projects.title: Ramen Campers - Creator
projects.description: Ramen Campers was a personal endeavor of mine to create my own custom off-road truck camper. It is a completely original design, engineered from the ground up!
